g.text: TrendDetective (data-expansion @ 524818c) — Four work areas and how they connect
toolbar: Pan · Point · Areas · Edit point · Delete
place search · topics · DD.MM.YYYY dates · interval
★ coverage box for cards without data
plot panel: tools per time frame / per year
region → area flow, else point flow
area → 1 point · nearest station of any source
② → ① setRegions · setArea · setResultData(map_layers) · fitToBounds
③ → ④ station search + bulk fetch
new on branch data-expansion, not yet on main
Two analysis paths: a point (or no area) goes through task.process_user_request, a predefined region through area_analysis.
Open issues between the areas are on page 5 "Feature gaps".
